visual_logic: Showcases the distinctively even, widely spaced peg teeth along the open margins of Wukongopterus, anchored to the character base.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the open jaws of a Wukongopterus, viewed from a direct three quarter view perspective, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The upper and lower jaws are opened wide to reveal an elongated hollow interior. Lined neatly along the outer margins is a rhythmic row of moderately sized, sharp ivory cone teeth that are separated by perfectly uniform gaps. At the base of the jaw, the stylized, slate-grey head displays smooth skin textures and large, warm, highly expressive character eyes peeking up. The asset is centered in a 1:1 square composition, keeping a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with soft contact shadows. Illuminated by balanced studio lighting to clearly delineate the tooth spacing.
